CarrotTopLift.name: Carrot top lift main routine
summary: Sprites $B7/$B8: slanted platforms that move diagonally in a 4-phase cycle ($80 frames each, speed from DATA_038C2A, Y speed is -X speed for $B7).
Mario can stand on the slope: his X offset from the sprite indexes the surface height table DATA_038BAA, and he is carried along by [$1491].
Parts of the original author's logic are unclear ('can't make sense of the details'), so some comments here are hedged.

CarrotTopLiftGfx.name: Carrot top lift graphics
summary: Draws three 16x16 tiles: entries 2-0 for sprite $B7, entries 5-3 (X-flipped) for sprite $B8.

summary: Screen Y offsets applied while the block bounces, indexed by [$1558] / 2.

InfoBox.name: Message box main routine
summary: Solid block (InvisBlkMainRt). When hit from below the timer [$1558] counts down; at 1 it plays sound $22 and sets [$1426] to message 1 or 2
(chosen by bit 4 of the sprite's X position). While the timer runs the layer 1 Y scroll is shifted temporarily to fake a bounce; the tile is forced to $C0.

TimedLift.name: Timed lift main routine
summary: Platform with a countdown number. Waits for Mario to stand on it, then moves right at speed $10 while the timer [$1570] counts down,
and falls with gravity when it reaches 0. Note: the 'AND #$00' at $038DC7 means the branch after it never happens.

TimedPlatDispY.name: Table: timed lift tile Y offsets

TimedPlatTileSize.name: Table: timed lift OAM size bits

TimedPlatNumTiles.name: Table: timed lift countdown digit tiles

TimedPlatformGfx.name: Timed lift graphics
summary: Draws two 16x16 platform halves plus an 8x8 countdown digit chosen by [$1570] / 64. The digit is omitted when the timer is below 8.
Sizes are written to the OAM size table by hand, so FinishOAMWrite is called with Y = $FF.

GreyCastleBlock.name: Grey moving castle block main routine
summary: Sprite state AND 3 selects a phase: speed 0, left $F0, 0, right $10, for $40 or $50 frames. Solid via InvisBlkMainRt.

GreyMoveBlkDispX.name: Table: grey castle block tile X offsets

GreyMoveBlkDispY.name: Table: grey castle block tile Y offsets

GreyMoveBlkTiles.name: Grey castle block graphics
summary: Draws a 2x2 arrangement of 16x16 tiles (32x32 pixels) with palette 9. The tile numbers table is at the start of the section.

StatueFireball.name: Bowser statue fireball main routine
summary: Moves horizontally at $10 (right) or $F0 (left) by sprite direction and hurts Mario on contact.

StatueFireDispX.name: Table: statue fireball tile X offsets

StatueFireballGfx.name: Statue fireball graphics
summary: Draws two 8x8 tiles. Animation frame is ([$14] / 2 AND 3); the right-moving version is flipped horizontally.

ReflectingFireball.name: Reflecting fireball main routine
summary: Draws with CODE_038FF2, then shares the Boo stream movement code (bounces off walls and ceilings).

BooStream.name: Boo stream main routine
summary: Sprite $B0 flies diagonally, bouncing off walls and floors (inverting the speed component). Every 8th frame (staggered per sprite) it spawns a trail tile
as extended sprite $0A. Also contains the shared movement code at CODE_038FA4 used by the reflecting fireball.
$038FF2: fireball graphics (tile $AC, palette flickers, flips follow the movement direction). $039020: spawn the Boo stream extended sprite.

FishinBooMaxSpeedX.name: Table: Fishin' Boo max X speed

FishinBooMaxSpeedY.name: Table: Fishin' Boo max Y speed

FishinBoo.name: Fishin' Boo main routine
summary: Boo that dangles a fishing hook. Accelerates horizontally toward Mario (away if [$18BF] is set) and bobs vertically by flipping the sign of Y acceleration at the max speed.
Faces Mario every 64 frames via a turn timer [$15AC]. [$1602] is the animation frame (1 while turning).

s0390EB.name: Table: Fishin' Boo hook hitbox X offsets
summary: Low bytes at $0390EB, high bytes at $0390EF, indexed by direction * 2 + frame.

s0390F3.name: Fishin' Boo hook contact check
summary: Builds a 4x4 hitbox $47 pixels below the sprite at the hook's X offset and hurts Mario if it overlaps.

FishinBooDispX.name: Table: Fishin' Boo tile X offsets
summary: Four sets of 10: (facing left, frame 0), (left, frame 1), (right, frame 0), (right, frame 1).

FishinBooDispY.name: Table: Fishin' Boo tile Y offsets

FishinBooTiles2.name: Tables: Fishin' Boo hook animation
summary: Hook tiles ($039174), hook flip bits ($039178) and body wobble flip bits ($03917C).

FishinBooGfx.name: Fishin' Boo graphics
summary: Draws 10 16x16 tiles: Boo body, rod, three line segments and the animated hook (last tile). The body tiles then get their flip bits cycled for a wobble.

FallingSpike.name: Falling spike main routine
summary: Draws the spike (tile $E0), shakes it horizontally while the timer [$1540] runs, then moves with gravity and runs a state routine through ExecutePtr (pointer table follows).
